notes.title: 4004-022 Update 1.2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34898564/4f63f67c3533e453aca6b809078f98ce9d22ce47.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone and welcome in the changes made to the game thanks to the update 1.2.

New ennemies : Multiples enemies were added in this new version :

-Catcher: Chase the player, when in contact with the player's space ship it explode.
-Explosifs Generator: Shoot explosifs at the Planet.
-Cinos: Have a chance to spawn when a day change, it will shoot misiles at the player's space ship.



Thanks you for playing 4004-022.

notes.title: 4004-022 Update 1.1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34898564/4f63f67c3533e453aca6b809078f98ce9d22ce47.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone and welcome in the changes made to the game thanks to the update 1.1.

[list]
[*] Difficulty: The difficulty of the game has been reviewed, the game is now
slightly easier, your spaceship and the planet receive less damage than before.

[*]Graphics: Slight change on the lighting.

[*]The "credits" button is now more reactive.
[/list]

Thanks you for playing 4004-022, hoping that this update will help you if you were encountering problems related to the difficulty.
